show.description: A high-stakes sports drama about Aryan Mehra, a disgraced ex-soldier fighting to reclaim his late father’s lost honor. With his mother’s unwavering support, Aryan battles corruption, family betrayal, and his own haunted past. His journey from underground fights to a final open arena showdown against his own blood, Veer Mehra, becomes a fight not just for victory—but for legacy itself.
